# noqeri/url 0.5.0

Strict percent-triplet validation, bounded application/x-www-form-urlencoded decoding, and query-pair counting.

The 0.4.0 exports are retained. License: GPL-3.0-only. This version is experimental until compiled and executed with the native Noqeri SDK. Host integration and OS-level safety are not implied by byte-level guards.

See `src/url.noqeri`, and `tests/depth_regression.noqeri`.
